query: INSERT INTO senses (message, ordinal, kind, specificity, confidence, explicitness, provenance, supersedes) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, (SELECT earlier.id FROM senses AS earlier WHERE earlier.message = ?1 AND earlier.ordinal = ?2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM senses AS later WHERE later.supersedes = earlier.id)))
